//測試手動輸入指令檔案
//包含多個分組的測試指令

==KANGAROO 指令組==

booting_state=uci -P /var/state get pega.led.booting_state
get_model=atcli at+cgmm
fw_version=uci -P /var/state get pega.fw.cur_ver
run_mfg_script=manufacture.sh
set_pega_model=fw_setenv pega_model MU310
get_pega_model=fw_printenv -n pega_model

==MB 指令組==

build time=cat /etc/pega_fwinfo
EXIT=exit
Login=root==>oelinux123==>cat /etc/pega_fwinfo
HW_revision=uci -P /var/state show pega.board.model
SW_Firmware_Version=uci -P /var/state show pega.fw.cur_ver
SIM CARD狀態:=uci -c /var/etc show cellstatus.sim.status

==LED 測試指令組==

LED signal OFF=echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:blue/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:green/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:red/brightness
LED status OFF=echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:blue/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:red/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:green/brightness
Check signal LED GREEN =echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:green/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:green/brightness
Check signal LED RED=echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:red/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:red/brightness
Check signal LED BLUE=echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:blue/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:blue/brightness

==網路測試指令組==

ping_ip_(IPv4)=ifconfig==>ping 192.168.225.1 -c 4
ping_ip_(IPv6)=ifconfig==>ping -6 fe80::3016:ffff:fe76:6157/64 -c 4
固定IP=ifconfig eth0 192.168.225.1
Ethernet_link_speed=ethtool eth0 | grep Speed | awk '{print "ethernet_linkSpeed=\047" $2 "\047"}'
get_eth_info=ethtool eth0
